subject: Request: QuantaMed dedicated GPU mix + short burst reservation hold
body:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quantamed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Dedicated H200S baseline + short burst window (QNT-4521)

Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — QuantaMed's infra team confirmed they want to move forward with a 12-month dedicated reservation. Two items in our ask that need to be surfaced to your deal desk/execs:

- Baseline: 4 x H200S (reserved) for 12 months, pinned to us-east-1.
- Short burst window: ability to scale to 8 H200S for up to 10 consecutive days during go-live spikes (expected Nov launch) with a defined overage rate rather than immediate cancellation of QoS.
- Commercial asks: 20% standard volume discount off list for the committed reservation, and a temporary overage discount (they proposed 35% off standard burst rate for the first 2 bursts).

I've attached the usage forecast and a first-pass SOW. Procurement would like a reservation hold while we finalize billing and a DocuSign SOW to avoid losing the current pricing. Can your team approve a temporary hold (14 days) and confirm policy on H200S for dedicated?

Appreciate any fast-tracked guidance — we need to get this to procurement by next Monday.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Infrastructure & Ops, QuantaMed
emily.zhao@quantamed.com
+1 415-555-0164

----
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Dedicated H200S baseline + short burst window (QNT-4521)

Team — forwarding QuantaMed's ask. High level: 4x H200S commitment, temporary burst to 8x for up to 10 days, request 20% reservation discount and 35% off burst overage for first two bursts, plus a 14-day reservation hold while DocuSign routing completes.

My recommendation: approve H200S baseline (fits our H200 program), allow a capped burst but shorten window to 7 days (operational risk), approve a 15% reservation discount (not 20%), and offer a tiered overage discount: 25% off standard burst rate for the first burst, 15% for the second. Approve a 14-day hold conditional on signed SOW and a $X security deposit (to be agreed).

Asking for a quick run from Deal Desk and exec signoff to confirm to procurement by Monday EOD.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Dedicated Solutions
Redwood Inference

----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Dedicated H200S baseline + short burst window (QNT-4521)

Irene — thanks for the rec. Quick margin and ops note after reviewing the forecast:

- Baseline 4x H200S (12mo): acceptable at 15% discount (list margin with our preferred config ~42% net).
- Burst to 8x H200S: operationally doable but we should limit burst windows to 7 days and require advance notice for any burst >72 hours.
- Overage pricing: if we go deeper than 25% off list for the first burst, we erode the margin significantly and set a pricing precedent. Recommend 25% / 15% cadence for 1st/2nd burst.
- Reservation hold (14 days): approve conditioned on signed DocuSign SOW + a refundable deposit equal to one week of expected burst consumption (we can calculate vs forecast).

I need Lauren (rev approval) and Jonas (ops capacity signoff) to greenlight the exceptions. If approved, I'll draft the amendment language for SOW and update the billing terms.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Director, Deal Desk

----
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Dedicated H200S baseline + short burst window (QNT-4521)

Karthik / Irene / Jonas — after review with finance, we can approve with the following conditions:

1) Reservation discount: 15% approved.
2) Burst: approve a max 7-day burst, with formal notice for any burst >72 hours.
3) Overage discount: 25% off standard burst rate for first burst, 15% for second.
4) Reservation hold: approve up to 14 days, but only after HubSpot deal stage is pushed to 'Paperwork' and DocuSign envelope is created; billing hold to lift only on executed SOW.
5) Security deposit: refundable deposit equal to one full day at peak burst consumption (not week) — finance prefers smaller exposure.

If Jonas signs off on capacity, I give exec approval to proceed.

Lauren
VP, Revenue Operations

----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Dedicated H200S baseline + short burst window (QNT-4521)

Lauren / team — ops check: 4x H200S baseline is fine for us-east-1. We can commit to allowing bursts up to 8x but with the following guardrails:

- Bursts are subject to capacity gating; we will prioritize production; in severe contention we may substitute H200S with an equally performing H200 variant and notify client 24 hours ahead.
- Cap overage throttle to per-minute billing at the agreed overage rate; do not allow open-ended trap charges.
- Approve security deposit equal to one day of forecasted peak (agree with Lauren).

With those operational constraints, I sign off. Lauren, you can issue the exec approval.

Jonas
Head of Dedicated Operations

----
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quantamed.com>, procurement@quantamed.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated H200S baseline + short burst window (QNT-4521)

Emily / QuantaMed procurement — thanks for the patience. Good news: executive approvals received with the following agreed terms (final language to be added to SOW amendment):

- Baseline commitment: 4 x H200S reserved for 12 months in us-east-1. Reservation discount: 15% off list.
- Burst: allowed up to 8 x H200S for a maximum of 7 consecutive days per burst. Advance notice required for any burst exceeding 72 hours.
- Overage rates: first burst eligible for 25% off standard burst rate; second burst eligible for 15% off. Subsequent bursts billed at standard rates. Billing is per-minute during burst windows.
- Reservation hold: Redwood will hold the reservation pricing for 14 days while DocuSign SOW is routed. The hold will be activated once the HubSpot deal stage is set to 'Paperwork' and a DocuSign envelope is created.
- Security deposit: refundable deposit equal to one day of forecasted peak burst consumption (details in amendment).
- Operational caveat: in extreme capacity contention we reserve the right to substitute with a comparable H200 variant with 24 hours' notice; we will not degrade below agreed performance targets without prior notice.

Next steps: Karthik will draft the SOW amendment and update the DocuSign. Irene will send a DocuSign link and the updated SOW by EOD Wednesday. Please confirm acceptance of these terms so we can lock the 14-day hold.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Dedicated Solutions
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: QuantaMed_Dedicated_Ask_20260828.pdf; usage_forecast_q3_q4.csv; proposed_sow_v1.docx
